prose: Fountain Interactive built Tiny Computers for the iPhone Duo: tiny emulated machines, including a working Commodore 64 command line, running on the dual-screen device. John Gruber links it as a must-try for Duo owners, while noting Cabel Sasser's observation that the ahistorical details betray a young, Claude-aided developer who never used the real machines.
highlights: Tiny emulated computers (Commodore 64 and more) for iPhone Duo
Sasser: fun but ahistorical - clearly Claude-aided work
Basis: short extract plus Daring Fireball note
basis: The extracted cache held under 400 characters, so this entry is based on that extract and the Daring Fireball link note.
